tasks.short: Select and mark trees and draw detailed access plans

steps.what: Check the forester's thinning or logging prescription and current tract, constraint and access-road maps
inputs: forester-issued tract prescription and revision
survey-owner current boundaries, constraints and known access-road layers
outputs: checked selection and planning references

steps.what: Select trees for thinning or logging and assess feasible access routes against actual forest conditions
inputs: checked selection and planning references
actual trees, terrain and access conditions
outputs: technician-selected trees and field-assessed access-route choices

steps.what: Physically mark the selected trees according to the authorised marking scheme
inputs: technician-selected trees and field-assessed access-route choices
actual trees and marking materials
outputs: actual marked trees and observed marking exceptions

steps.what: Capture actual tree-marking locations, access-route geometry, field constraints and exceptions for the detailed plan
inputs: actual marked trees and observed marking exceptions
technician-selected trees and field-assessed access-route choices
checked selection and planning references
outputs: technician-captured tree and access-road features with status and field notes

steps.what: Draw the detailed thinning or logging plan including marked trees, access roads, constraints and a map legend
inputs: technician-captured tree and access-road features with status and field notes
checked selection and planning references
outputs: complete draft detailed tree and access-road plan

steps.what: Check field correspondence, road status and map detail and approve the final plan record
inputs: complete draft detailed tree and access-road plan
technician-captured tree and access-road features with status and field notes
outputs: approved detailed tree and access-road plan v1

steps.what: Save the approved detailed plan in the same internal tract planning record
inputs: approved detailed tree and access-road plan v1
outputs: stored detailed thinning or logging plan

tasks.design: Configure field forms and map layouts in the {OTHER} geographic information system using the forester's prescription in the {DOCS}. The technician selects and marks trees, captures actual features and road choices, then checks a native map rendering before approving and saving the detailed plan.
tasks.previous_blocker: Map layout work can repeat known tract references after the field selection and marking have already been done.
tasks.enabler_now: Native geographic forms and layouts can reuse captured geometry and symbol rules without choosing trees or routes.
tasks.still_hard: Tree condition, habitat constraints and actual access feasibility need field judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise a tree or route whose local condition overrides a plausible map representation.

ambition.what: Compare the access implications of an alternative thinning area before recommending its detailed plan.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-5 for tract layers and field access; consult crews about changed recording

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: geographic information systems can render detailed plans from explicitly captured point and road features using configured layouts.

assumptions: Boundary includes tree selection, physical marking, actual geometry capture and detailed drawing including access roads. Logging and road construction remain separate and earn no saving.

Foresters supply tract id, prescription and revision; map owners supply versioned boundary and constraint layers. s4 explicitly counts tree id, actual mark status, location, route geometry, existing/planned status and field-note capture. Missing geometry is surveyed or drawn manually within s4, not invented by a machine.

OTHER is the geographic information system. Native forms and layouts first. s4 retains twelve hours for actual feature capture; only repeated tract metadata and form navigation change. s5 renders captured features and does not decide access routes.

All shares and reductions are provisional scenarios, not measured baselines. Current digital map work is assumed, not historical paper rekeying. Same-system save remains fully retained; approval records the technician's final plan and does not grant logging permission.
unknowns: Completeness and accuracy of existing tract layers
Existing native field form and map layout support
research_questions: Can every depicted selected tree and road segment be traced to an actual captured feature?
Does the layout distinguish existing access from a proposed route?

already_counted.description: Inspect rendered tree, access-road and constraint detail

incremental.description: Maintain field forms, map symbols and layout references

approvals.approved_version: approved detailed tree and access-road plan v1; edits require s6 again

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central gross 15.5 minus 1 upkeep gives 14.5. High allows 4.5 extra hours correcting feature and layout exceptions; low covers existing configured layouts or insufficient geometry.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Supervise actual forest and land-use operations

steps.what: Review current nursery, timber-harvest, grazing or disease-control work plans and actual crew progress for the assigned activity
inputs: forester-approved assigned activity plan and map revision
crew-produced actual work status and issues
outputs: checked assigned operation context and gaps

steps.what: Supervise the actual forest nursery, timber harvesting, livestock grazing or disease and insect control operation assigned to the technician
inputs: checked assigned operation context and gaps
actual assigned activity, workers and field conditions
outputs: actual supervision findings and required corrections

steps.what: Discuss findings and clarify practical corrections with the workers and forester as needed
inputs: actual supervision findings and required corrections
actual worker and forester responses
outputs: actual clarification and unresolved supervision concerns

steps.what: Record actual operation progress, findings and unresolved concerns in the existing supervision record
inputs: actual supervision findings and required corrections
actual clarification and unresolved supervision concerns
checked assigned operation context and gaps
outputs: complete actual supervision record

steps.what: Check and approve the final actual supervision record
inputs: complete actual supervision record
outputs: approved supervision record v1

steps.what: Save the approved record in the same internal supervision record
inputs: approved supervision record v1
outputs: stored actual supervision findings

tasks.design: Configure the {PROJECT} work view to link the assigned activity and current {OTHER} geographic map, then reuse those references in a supervision form. Actual observation, worker discussion and finding capture remain with the technician; only navigation and repeated metadata change.
tasks.previous_blocker: Supervisors can need several references to establish the current assigned operation and record its findings.
tasks.enabler_now: Native work views and linked forms can reuse known plan and activity identifiers.
tasks.still_hard: Work quality, changing field conditions and appropriate corrections require direct supervision.
tasks.human_edge: Notice an operation deviating from its intent and adapt the explanation to the crew and conditions.

ambition.what: No broader operational or treatment authority is assumed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-5 for work-plan access and staff consultation if attribution changes

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: project work views and linked supervision forms can reuse existing activity and map references.

assumptions: This is one assigned operation from the statement's list, not simultaneous nursery, harvest, grazing and control work. Boundary includes preparation, field supervision, discussion and an existing supervision record; crew work remains outside the focal denominator.

Foresters supply plan id, revision and activity; crews supply already recorded actual status. If crew status is absent, the technician gathers it manually in s1/s2; no free reporting obligation is transferred to crews.
OTHER means the geographic information system. s4 retains seven hours for actual findings and concerns; only known work identifiers can be prefilled. No machine infers completion from a plan.

Native configuration first. Shares and reductions are provisional scenarios, not measured baselines. If no formal supervision record exists, remeasure that workflow instead of inventing paperwork savings. Same-system save is fully retained.
unknowns: Quality of existing crew status and map links
research_questions: Does a linked work view reduce preparation while preserving missing-status warnings?
Does the record distinguish actual findings from planned work?

already_counted.description: Capture and check actual supervision findings

incremental.description: Maintain activity-map links and supervision form fields

approvals.approved_version: approved supervision record v1; edits require s5 again

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central gross 9 minus 0.5 upkeep gives 8.5. High allows 2.5 additional hours checking incomplete status links; low covers an already linked native view and form.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop and maintain conservation computer databases

steps.what: Define the conservation database's records, fields, identifiers, validation rules and permitted access with the data requirements
inputs: forester or scientist requirements and existing source examples
data-owner access and retention requirements
outputs: technician-authored field dictionary, relationships and validation specification

steps.what: Develop the draft computer database structure and record-entry forms from the explicit specification
inputs: technician-authored field dictionary, relationships and validation specification
existing authorised database and form-builder environment
outputs: complete draft database structure and form definition

steps.what: Validate the draft structure and form behaviour against source examples in a non-mutating preview
inputs: complete draft database structure and form definition
forester or scientist requirements and existing source examples
technician-authored field dictionary, relationships and validation specification
outputs: actual preview-validation results tied to the draft definition

steps.what: Review actual validation results and approve the exact database structure and form definition for application
inputs: complete draft database structure and form definition
actual preview-validation results tied to the draft definition
outputs: approved database definition v1

steps.what: Apply the approved database and form definition in the existing authorised database environment
inputs: approved database definition v1
outputs: applied conservation database structure and forms

steps.what: Prepare database maintenance additions and corrections from actual source records and inspect duplicate, missing and invalid fields
inputs: applied conservation database structure and forms
source-owner existing records with source id, version, record key and field values
outputs: complete draft maintenance batch and explicit validation exceptions

steps.what: Resolve record identity and substantive data exceptions and complete the final maintenance batch
inputs: complete draft maintenance batch and explicit validation exceptions
source-owner existing records with source id, version, record key and field values
outputs: complete resolved conservation data maintenance batch

steps.what: Approve the exact final database additions and corrections for commit
inputs: complete resolved conservation data maintenance batch
outputs: approved conservation maintenance batch v1

steps.what: Commit the approved maintenance batch in the same conservation database
inputs: approved conservation maintenance batch v1
outputs: committed conservation database updates and change log

tasks.design: Configure native table, form and validation features in the {DATA_PLATFORM} from the technician's explicit specification in the {DOCS}. Preview structure changes before approval and application, then validate source-record maintenance batches, resolve semantic exceptions and separately approve each final commit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Record structures, forms and routine validation can require repeated bespoke setup or manual checks.
tasks.enabler_now: Native database builders and declarative validation can express ordinary identifiers, required fields and relationships without a model loop.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing useful definitions and resolving whether two observations describe the same entity require domain understanding.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish a legitimate ecological variation from an erroneous record and preserve provenance.

ambition.what: Provide a traceable conservation dataset with explicit source versions and unresolved-quality flags.

reach.task: Define a reusable conservation data dictionary
reach.learn: Keys, provenance, validation and access design.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-7 for source and database access and consultation if employee attribution changes

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native database forms and declarative checks can implement explicit field rules and stage additions for review before commit.

assumptions: Boundary combines development and recurring maintenance of the technician's conservation database, not a production enterprise-platform migration. Shares are a provisional mix of those phases and must be reweighted to actual work frequency.

The technician captures all field definitions and rules in s1. Existing source owners supply source id, version, record key and values; missing or unstructured fields are manually entered in retained s6 time or flagged, not freely extracted.

s3 uses an existing non-mutating preview with supplied examples; no hidden test database writes occur. s5 applies only the already checked definition. Maintenance starts against that applied structure and s8 approval occurs after all record corrections exist.

Native configuration first. s6 saves only repeated field setup and mechanical validation effort; s7 retains all semantic and identity decisions. If structured sources or native staging are absent, the proposed reduction falls.

All shares and reductions are provisional scenarios, not measured baselines. Both same-system apply/commit steps stay fully retained; system runtime earns no saving. New schema and rule upkeep is explicitly charged.
unknowns: Existing database builder and preview capabilities
Source record structure and maintenance frequency
research_questions: Can a native form and validation definition reproduce one existing database without custom code?
Do staged corrections preserve source provenance and unresolved exceptions?

already_counted.description: Check native structure and form configuration
Inspect maintenance staging and mechanical validation exceptions

incremental.description: Maintain validation rules, source mappings and preview regression examples

approvals.approved_version: approved database definition v1 including forms and validation rules; edits void approval
approved conservation maintenance batch v1; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central gross 24 minus 2 upkeep gives 22. High allows five additional hours handling unstructured sources and unsupported form rules; low covers existing native configuration or manual exceptions absorbing all gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Inspect trees and collect traceable damage samples

steps.what: Check the assigned tree inspection area and current sampling instructions for insect or disease damage
inputs: forester-assigned inspection area and purpose
laboratory-issued sampling instructions and existing sample identifiers
outputs: checked inspection and sample reference

steps.what: Inspect actual trees to locate insect and disease damage and choose relevant sample locations
inputs: checked inspection and sample reference
actual trees and visible conditions
outputs: actual damage observations and technician-chosen sample locations

steps.what: Collect samples of plants, seeds, foliage, bark or roots as appropriate and associate each physical sample with its identifier
inputs: actual damage observations and technician-chosen sample locations
laboratory-issued sampling instructions and existing sample identifiers
actual plant material and sample containers
outputs: actual identified physical samples and collection observations

steps.what: Record actual tree damage observations and sample identifier, material, location and collection time
inputs: actual damage observations and technician-chosen sample locations
actual identified physical samples and collection observations
checked inspection and sample reference
outputs: complete actual inspection and collection record

steps.what: Check physical sample correspondence and approve the final actual inspection and collection record
inputs: complete actual inspection and collection record
actual identified physical samples and collection observations
outputs: approved inspection and collection record v1

steps.what: Save the approved actual inspection and sample record in the same field records system
inputs: approved inspection and collection record v1
outputs: stored actual tree inspection and sample collection record

tasks.design: Configure current inspection references and a sample-linked field form in the {OTHER} geographic field records system, using instructions from the {DOCS}. The technician inspects trees, selects and collects actual samples, enters observations and verifies physical sample correspondence before saving the approved record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reference lookup and repeated area or sample metadata can add work around physical inspection and collection.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked field forms can reuse checked inspection-area and issued sample identifiers without inferring damage.
tasks.still_hard: Selecting representative material and distinguishing damage signs require field expertise.
tasks.human_edge: Notice subtle damage and avoid collecting an unrepresentative or poorly identified specimen.

ambition.what: No new diagnostic authority or sampling service is assumed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-4 for inspection and sample references and field access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: field records forms can reuse area and sample references while people enter actual collection observations.

assumptions: Boundary includes inspection, physical sample collection, actual sample association and its existing collection record. Laboratory analysis and later sample transport are separate work and yield no saving.

Foresters supply area and purpose; the laboratory supplies current instructions and pre-issued sample ids. s3 includes physically associating identifiers with samples. If labels are not already issued, their preparation must be counted there rather than assumed free.

OTHER is the geographic field records system. s4 retains twelve hours for actual damage, sample material, location, time and correction capture. Only already checked area and sample metadata is reused; no machine diagnoses disease.

Native configuration first. Shares and reductions are provisional scenarios, not measurements. Same-system save stays fully retained. Any separate laboratory submission or external report requires its own captured work and final-version gate, not a hidden automatic send.
unknowns: Actual specimen labelling and record practices
research_questions: Can each recorded sample be matched to its actual container and collection location?
Does prefill reduce only repeated metadata while preserving observation capture?

already_counted.description: Capture and check actual observations and sample correspondence

incremental.description: Maintain inspection and sample form reference mappings

approvals.approved_version: approved inspection and collection record v1; edits require s5 again

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central gross 7 minus 0.5 upkeep gives 6.5. High allows 2.5 additional hours correcting sample-reference exceptions; low applies where existing native forms already remove the metadata work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The technician spends less time assembling maps and repeated record fields while retaining field judgement, physical marking and sampling, and data-meaning decisions.
reach: Define reusable conservation data dictionaries with data specialists after learning keys, provenance and access design.
role.ambitious_version: Provide detailed forest plans and conservation datasets whose field evidence, assumptions and unresolved issues remain traceable.
